# MeiFacsimileLoader { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader }

```python
loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader()
```

Load the surfaces and zones of an MEI file's facsimile.

Each ``surface`` holding zones becomes a page: a segment line of its
accolades, in ``pixels`` (``int``). An accolade is one horizontal piece
of the page's time path, a :class:`DiscreteGraphicalTimeline` as long as
the piece, stating the area it stands for in ``meta["box"]`` and its
image in ``meta["image"]``. Each zone taking part is a
:class:`~timetoalign.core.Box` event of the accolade it lies on, holding
the zone's shape in the image's pixels. :attr:`facs` keeps which zones
each element of the encoding points to.

For a Box on an accolade, ``start`` is the zone's least x minus the x of
the accolade's ``meta["box"]`` and ``duration`` is the zone's x extent,
so the box, the shape and the interval agree.

:meth:`create_timeline` gives the whole facsimile as one volume (a
segment line of the pages), :meth:`create_timelines` one root per page,
:meth:`create_paths` the time paths made from the zones.

Known limits: only the first ``graphic`` of a surface is read, and zone
coordinates are taken as its pixels (the surface's own ``@ulx`` ..
``@lry`` are not read, so a surface whose corners measure another space
than the graphic's pixels has its zones placed as if they were the
graphic's pixels); a graphic size in a unit other than pixels (``cm``,
``in``, ...) states no pixel size and is not read; MEI states no
accolades, so they are found from the zones' left edges unless paths
are given, and a page whose zones are not listed accolade by accolade
needs a path; a zone without ``xml:id`` is minted ``box_N`` on its
accolade and cannot be pointed to; an element without ``xml:id`` is
left out of :attr:`facs`, and a zone stating no coordinates out of the
timelines (:attr:`zones_without_coordinates` lists those with an id). A
zone whose ``@points`` are not four points bounding a convex area (five
points, a concave or crossed outline) cannot be a
:class:`~timetoalign.core.Quadrilateral` and refuses the file, the
message naming the zone and the reason. The volume takes no name from
the file's title.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

The pages of an MEI file as timelines, the measures of the first
accolade, and the zones a measure points to::

    loader = MeiFacsimileLoader.from_file("chorale_facsimile.mei")
    (page,) = loader.create_timelines(zone_types="measure")
    accolade = page.get_child(page.list_children()[0])
    boxes = accolade.get_events().table.to_pylist()
    zones = loader.facs["m-43"]

### clear { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader.clear }

```python
loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader.clear()
```

Forget the loaded file.

### create_paths { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader.create_paths }

```python
loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader.create_paths(zone_types=None)
```

Make each surface's time path from its zones.

The zones taking part are grouped into accolades in document order
(:meth:`~timetoalign.loader.graphical.paths.TimeAxisPath.from_boxes`):
a zone whose left edge lies left of the previous zone's by more than
half the span of all left edges begins the next accolade. Each
accolade is one horizontal piece from its zones' least x to their
greatest, its strip the zones' y extent. These are the paths
:meth:`create_timeline` and :meth:`create_timelines` use where none
is given; a path that needs correcting can be rewritten and passed
to them as ``paths``.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                               | Description                                                                                     | Default   |
|------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| zone_types | [str](`str`) \| [Collection](`collections.abc.Collection`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | The ``@type`` of the zones taking part (one, or several); None for every zone with coordinates. | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                                | Description                                                    |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`) \| [int](`int`), [PiecewisePath](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.paths.PiecewisePath`)\] | Per surface with a zone taking part, in document order, its    |
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`) \| [int](`int`), [PiecewisePath](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.paths.PiecewisePath`)\] | path; a surface is named by its ``xml:id``, or by its position |
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`) \| [int](`int`), [PiecewisePath](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.paths.PiecewisePath`)\] | in the file (from 0) where it has none.                        |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                                                                   |
|--------|--------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [RuntimeError](`RuntimeError`) | If no file has been loaded.                                                   |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)     | If no path can be made from a surface's zones (an accolade without x extent). |

### create_timeline { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader.create_timeline }

```python
loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader.create_timeline(
    uid=None,
    name=None,
    paths=None,
    zone_types=None,
    page_ids=None,
    accolade_ids=None,
    box_ids=None,
)
```

Create the facsimile as one volume: a segment line of its pages.

The pages are those of :meth:`create_timelines`, in document order,
each a segment of the volume; the volume's length is the sum of
theirs. The volume is locked.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                                                               | Description                                  | Default   |
|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|-----------|
| uid          | [str](`str`) \| None                                                               | The volume's id; minted ``dgt_N`` when None. | `None`    |
| name         | [str](`str`) \| None                                                               | The volume's name.                           | `None`    |
| paths        | [Paths](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.mei_facsimile.Paths`)                        | As :meth:`create_timelines`.                 | `None`    |
| zone_types   | [str](`str`) \| [Collection](`collections.abc.Collection`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | As :meth:`create_timelines`.                 | `None`    |
| page_ids     | [Ids](`timetoalign.loader.graphical._pages.Ids`)                                   | As :meth:`create_timelines`.                 | `None`    |
| accolade_ids | [Ids](`timetoalign.loader.graphical._pages.Ids`)                                   | As :meth:`create_timelines`.                 | `None`    |
| box_ids      | [Ids](`timetoalign.loader.graphical._pages.Ids`)                                   | As :meth:`create_timelines`.                 | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                               | Description                                                           |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [SegmentLine](`timetoalign.timelines.SegmentLine`) | The volume, a ``SegmentLine[SegmentLine[DiscreteGraphicalTimeline]]`` |
|        | [SegmentLine](`timetoalign.timelines.SegmentLine`) | (a ``SegmentLine[DiscreteGraphicalTimeline]`` where every page is     |
|        | [SegmentLine](`timetoalign.timelines.SegmentLine`) | one line given in ``paths``).                                         |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                                                                                                                    |
|--------|--------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [RuntimeError](`RuntimeError`) | If no file has been loaded.                                                                                                    |
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`)         | As :meth:`create_timelines`.                                                                                                   |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)     | As :meth:`create_timelines`; also if no surface has a time path, or some pages are built of accolades and others are one line. |

### create_timelines { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader.create_timelines }

```python
loader.graphical.MeiFacsimileLoader.create_timelines(
    paths=None,
    zone_types=None,
    page_ids=None,
    accolade_ids=None,
    box_ids=None,
)
```

Create one root timeline per surface, in document order.

A surface's page is a locked segment line of its accolades, in
``pixels`` (``int``): its id the surface's ``xml:id`` (minted
``dgt_N`` where it has none), its name the surface's ``@n``
(``page_N`` by its position in the call, from 1, where it has
none), its length the sum of its accolades', ``meta["image"]`` the
graphic's ``@target``. It states no ``meta["box"]``: its axis is a
concatenation of accolades, not an area, and the graphic's size is
on no timeline.

The accolades are the pieces of the surface's time path, made from
the zones taking part (:meth:`create_paths`) unless ``paths`` gives
one. Each is a :class:`DiscreteGraphicalTimeline` named
``accolade_K`` (K from 1 on its page) whose length is its piece's
``x1 - x0``, with ``meta["box"]`` the piece's strip (``x0``, ``y -
tolerance``, ``x1 - x0``, ``2 * tolerance``) and ``meta["image"]``.

Each zone taking part is a Box event of its accolade: the one it was
grouped into or, on a given path, the piece it lies on (the piece
whose x extent holds the zone's and whose strip holds the zone's
vertical centre; of several the nearest). Its id is the zone's
``xml:id`` (minted ``box_N`` on its accolade where it has none); its
shape is the zone's coordinates as written; its start is the shape's
least x less the accolade's ``x0``.

A surface without a zone taking part and without a given path is
left out.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                                                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default   |
|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| paths        | [Paths](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.mei_facsimile.Paths`)                        | Time paths replacing those made from the zones: one path where the file holds one surface, or a mapping from a surface's ``xml:id`` or position in the file (from 0) to its path. Where zones take part, a path is a ``HorizontalLinePath`` (the page is then one plain timeline along it) or a ``PiecewisePath``. | `None`    |
| zone_types   | [str](`str`) \| [Collection](`collections.abc.Collection`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | The ``@type`` of the zones taking part (one, or several); None for every zone with coordinates.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `None`    |
| page_ids     | [Ids](`timetoalign.loader.graphical._pages.Ids`)                                   | The pages' ids, replacing the surfaces' ``xml:id``: one id per page in document order, or a template filled with ``str.format`` from ``page`` (the page's position in the call, from 1) and ``n`` (the running count).                                                                                             | `None`    |
| accolade_ids | [Ids](`timetoalign.loader.graphical._pages.Ids`)                                   | The accolades' ids (minted ``dgt_N`` when None): one id per accolade in document order, or a template filled from ``page``, ``accolade`` (its position on its page) and ``n``.                                                                                                                                     | `None`    |
| box_ids      | [Ids](`timetoalign.loader.graphical._pages.Ids`)                                   | The Boxes' ids, replacing the zones' ``xml:id`` (see :attr:`facs`): one id per zone taking part in document order, or a template filled from ``page``, ``accolade``, ``box`` (its position in its accolade) and ``n`` (the zone's position among those taking part in the call): ``box_ids="m{n}"``.               | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                             | Description           |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[DiscreteGraphicalTimeline](`timetoalign.timelines.DiscreteGraphicalTimeline`)\] | The pages' timelines. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|--------|--------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [RuntimeError](`RuntimeError`) | If no file has been loaded.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`)         | If ``paths`` names a surface the file does not hold.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)     | If one path is given for a file of several surfaces or a surface is given two; zones take part on a path that is neither a horizontal line nor a ``PiecewisePath``; a zone lies on no piece of its surface's path; an ids argument does not fit the call or gives one id to two timelines; or a path holds a number the pixel axis cannot hold exactly. Nothing is built then. |
